# Style Guide

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:StyleGuide`](gmeow-StyleGuide.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StyleGuide>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The voice payload of a persona or register — prose whose REGISTER IS THE CONTENT. The prose-voice doctrine (gap analysis): voice documents attach byte-perfect via [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) (content-digested Documents carrying [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](../properties/gmeow-hasAboutness.md) [`gmeow:aboutnessEnacts`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessEnacts.md) — the document does not describe the voice, it IS the voice), never shredded into pseudo-quantified style triples. Style dimensions, when stated, are prose.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:StyleGuide`](gmeow-StyleGuide.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the voice payload of a persona or register — prose whose register IS the content, exemplified byte-perfect by enacting documents.

### Avoid when

- Avoid shredding voice into pseudo-quantified style triples (style dimensions, when stated, are prose) and avoid an exemplar document that merely describes the voice — it must enact it ([`gmeow:aboutnessEnacts`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessEnacts.md)).

### How to use

- Mint the guide, name what it voices with [`gmeow:styleGuideFor`](../properties/gmeow-styleGuideFor.md), and attach byte-perfect enacting documents via [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) (each carrying [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md) and [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](../properties/gmeow-hasAboutness.md) [`gmeow:aboutnessEnacts`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessEnacts.md)).

### Examples

- ex:clinicalVoice a [`gmeow:StyleGuide`](gmeow-StyleGuide.md); [`gmeow:styleGuideFor`](../properties/gmeow-styleGuideFor.md) ex:drChen; [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md) ex:sampleNote.
